current_evidence: The council's 'Planning application checklists' page lists the four Central Lincolnshire Local Validation Lists (Full, Householder, LBC, Outline) as adopted and in effect from Monday 20 May 2024. It notes that a review consultation closed on 7 June 2026 and the existing lists apply until revised lists are adopted.

issues.detail: Grokbot captured only about 10 requirement types. It missed most Category 2 and 3 local items in the Full and Outline lists: Energy Statement and Energy Efficiency Checklist (CLLP S6-S8), Ecological Impact Assessment (S60), Biodiversity Gain Statement, Drainage Statement (S21), Agricultural Land Classification survey (S14/S67), Green Wedge Assessment (S63), Minerals Assessment (LCCMWLP M11), Transport Statement/Assessment and Travel Plan (S47/S49), Aviation/defence assessment, Shadow Flicker and Glint & Glare assessments (S14/S53), Agricultural Workers Dwelling Justification (S5), Affordable Housing / First Homes needs assessment (S4/S22), Custom/self-build plot passports (NS24), Town centre / retail sequential assessment, Marketing Report, Alternative employment sites assessment, Demolition Justification Statement (S11), Open Space Assessment (S51), Flood Risk Assessment (Flood Zone 2/3, over 1 ha in Zone 1, critical drainage areas), LVIA (S62), Groundwater Risk Assessment, Noise, Dust, Odour/Air Quality and External Lighting assessments, Unexploded Ordnance / Land Quality, Contaminated Land Assessment (S56/S83) and S106 Heads of Terms.
issues.evidence: Full Planning Application Validation List, Category 2 'Local' and Category 3 'Other' tables

issues.detail: Grokbot mixed superseded January 2023 per-type checklists with the May 2024 adopted lists. The Health Impact Assessment trigger ('25 dwellings or more or 0.5ha') and the Full planning Arboricultural and Advertisement rows come from 2023-01 'validation_checklist_-_full_planning_application.pdf' and 'full_application_with_advertisement_consent'. For Full and Outline applications the adopted 2024 lists replace those; the 2024 list cites policy S54 for HIA.

These items are a fee pointer or a fragment, not requirements: the tab_item 'Correct Planning Fee See current fees at: pdf ...', and the Householder and Full BNG rows whose trigger begins with that same fee text.
issues.evidence: tab_items 'Submission rules'; BNG trigger_excerpt 'Correct Planning Fee See current fees at: pdf Biodiversity Net Gain...'

issues.detail: Several triggers are cut-off fragments from table cells: Structural Survey 'combined with Structural Survey.'; Highways 'public highway, visibility splays, landscaping, car parking...' (block plan content, not a highways trigger); Design and Access Statement merges with the 'Site Location Plan 1 3' column; Floor plans / Block plan rows are run-on scale text. The Listed building consent 'Floor plans' row cites 1:20/1:5 joinery detail, not the floor-plan requirement.

Reserved matters, s73 variation, Discharge of conditions, LDC, Works to trees and Prior approvals are marked '(none) - national requirements only'. The council publishes specific checklists for each type (Approval of Reserved Matters, Variation or Removal of Conditions, Approval of Details Reserved by Conditions, LDC, Tree Applications, Part 1/Part 20 prior approvals). 'Highways / access details' is listed under Householder and Listed building consent with no basis in those lists.
issues.evidence: 'Planning Application Checklists' section of the council page
issues.grok_comment: The main point stands: separate RM, s73, DoC, LDC, tree and prior-approval checklists exist in raw. But the 'Highways' excerpt does appear verbatim in the 2024 Householder and LBC lists (raw 32500727f0, 96384a4181) as block-plan content, so it is mislabelled rather than 'no basis'.
issues.claude_response: Partly accepted. The Highways text is block-plan content (mislabelled, not baseless). The missing type checklists stand.

issues.detail: A review of the Central Lincolnshire local validation lists is in progress (consultation from 11 May 2026, closed 7 June 2026). The workbook should flag that a replacement list is pending.
issues.evidence: 'Review of Local Validation Lists' section; consultation closed Sunday 7 June 2026

summary: Grokbot's link is the current adopted Central Lincolnshire Full Applications list (effective 20 May 2024; a review closed in June 2026 is not yet adopted). Grokbot missed most of the roughly 30 Category 2 and 3 local requirements and mixed in triggers from superseded 2023 checklists.

withdrawn_issues.detail: The list date is taken from the URL upload folder (2024-05-01). The council page states the lists came into effect on 20 May 2024.
withdrawn_issues.grok_comment: The workbook records list dates at month precision by convention, so 2024-05-01 is consistent with the 20 May 2024 effective date. Only the date basis (upload folder) could be better.
withdrawn_issues.claude_response: Accepted. The workbook stores list dates to the month, so the value is right; only the date-basis label could be better. Not a Grokbot error.

grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
